snippet.title: Scrabdackle Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase: September 2025
snippet.description:
The magical misadventure of a novice wizard thrown (literally) into the unfamiliar world outside. Go on a sprawling hand-drawn adventure with spells to study, bosses to best, and a huge handcrafted world to traverse on the long journey home.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1578720/Scrabdackle/

Visit https://www.sixoneindie.com/showcase for more information.

Love indie games? Subscribe and hit the bell!

Six One Indie is a grassroots collective focused on making gaming showcases, awards, and overall visibility more approachable for independent developers.
